reason: A Git and GitHub repository management plugin with a visual settings interface, local Git operations, GitHub API integration, repository creation, and agent-callable tools.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置页中提供本地 Git 仓库可视化、分支与提交管理，以及通过 GitHub API 创建仓库和推送代码的功能。
summaries.en: Provides DSH with visual local Git repository management, branch and commit operations, and GitHub API integration for repository creation and code pushing.

capabilities: Reads local Git repository status, branches, commits, and changed files
Executes local Git initialization, checkout, commit, and history operations
Uses a GitHub Personal Access Token to test connectivity, list repositories, create repositories, and push code
Provides agent-callable tools for Git and GitHub repository operations
Stores GitHub account configuration and token in a local configuration file
